user_story: As a guest, I want to retrieve a booking by its ID so that I can see its details.

positive.title: Retrieve existing booking by valid ID
steps: Send a request to retrieve booking with a valid ID.
Receive a response from the server.
positive.expected_result: Booking details are returned with the correct information.

positive.title: Retrieve booking details for a future date
steps: Send a request to retrieve booking with a valid future ID.
Receive a response from the server.
positive.expected_result: Booking details are returned showing future date information.

negative.title: Retrieve booking with an invalid ID
steps: Send a request to retrieve booking with an invalid ID.
Receive a response from the server.
negative.expected_result: Error message is returned indicating the booking ID is not found.

negative.title: Retrieve booking with an empty ID
steps: Send a request to retrieve booking with an empty ID.
Receive a response from the server.
negative.expected_result: Error message is returned indicating the booking ID is required.

negative.title: Retrieve booking with a non-numeric ID
steps: Send a request to retrieve booking with a non-numeric ID.
Receive a response from the server.
negative.expected_result: Error message is returned indicating the booking ID is invalid.

edge.title: Retrieve booking with a very large ID
steps: Send a request to retrieve booking with an extremely large numeric ID.
Receive a response from the server.
edge.expected_result: Error message is returned indicating the booking ID is invalid or out of range.

edge.title: Retrieve booking with a valid ID after a long period of inactivity
steps: Send a request to retrieve booking with a valid ID after a system timeout or long inactivity period.
Receive a response from the server.
edge.expected_result: Booking details are returned correctly, indicating persistence of data.
